steps.command:
ls -la /workspace/
echo "--- INPUT HEAD ---"
head -20 /workspace/input.csv
echo "--- EXPECTED HEAD ---"
head -20 /workspace/expected.csv
echo "--- COUNTS ---"
wc -l /workspace/input.csv /workspace/expected.csv

cd /workspace
echo "--- tabs? ---"
grep -c $'\t' input.csv || true
echo "--- comma counts distribution ---"
awk -F',' '{print NF}' input.csv | sort | uniq -c
echo "--- sample lines vary ---"
sed -n '1p;500000p;999999p;1000000p' input.csv | cat -A
echo "--- expected samples ---"
sed -n '500000p;999999p;1000000p' expected.csv | cat -A
echo "--- last byte input/expected ---"
tail -c 50 input.csv | xxd | tail -3
tail -c 50 expected.csv | xxd | tail -3

cd /workspace
head -1000 input.csv > /tmp/in.csv
cat > /tmp/test.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
echo "--- register lengths ---"
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -c 'source /tmp/test.vim' /tmp/in.csv; echo "exit=$?"
diff <(head -1000 expected.csv) /tmp/in.csv && echo "MATCH"
head -3 /tmp/in.csv

cd /workspace
head -1000 input.csv > /tmp/in.csv
head -1000 expected.csv > /tmp/exp1000.csv
cat > /tmp/test.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -S /tmp/test.vim /tmp/in.csv; echo "exit=$?"
cmp /tmp/exp1000.csv /tmp/in.csv && echo "MATCH1000"
echo "--- register content lengths ---"
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -c 'source /tmp/test.vim' /tmp/in.csv
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -c 'call setreg("a", ":s/ //g\r")' -c 'call setreg("b", "gUU")' -c 'call setreg("c", ":s/\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")' -c 'echo len(getreg("a"))+len(getreg("b"))+len(getreg("c"))' -c 'qa!'

cd /workspace
head -100000 input.csv > /tmp/in100k.csv
cat > /tmp/test.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
start=$(date +%s)
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -S /tmp/test.vim /tmp/in100k.csv; echo "exit=$?"
end=$(date +%s); echo "elapsed=$((end-start))s"
head -100000 expected.csv > /tmp/e100k
cmp /tmp/e100k /tmp/in100k.csv && echo MATCH100k

cd /workspace
cp input.csv /tmp/input_backup.csv
cat > apply_macros.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
cat apply_macros.vim
echo "=== RUN ==="
start=$(date +%s)
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /workspace/input.csv -S /workspace/apply_macros.vim; ec=$?
end=$(date +%s); echo "exit=$ec elapsed=$((end-start))s"
echo "=== COMPARE ==="
cmp /workspace/expected.csv /workspace/input.csv && echo "BYTE-FOR-BYTE MATCH"
ls -l /workspace/input.csv /workspace/expected.csv

cd /workspace
cp input.csv /tmp/before.csv
cat > apply_macros.vim <<'VIM'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //ge\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/e\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIM
cat apply_macros.vim
echo "=== idempotency run on already-transformed input ==="
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /workspace/input.csv -S /workspace/apply_macros.vim; echo "exit=$?"
cmp /tmp/before.csv /workspace/input.csv && echo "UNCHANGED"
cmp /workspace/expected.csv /workspace/input.csv && echo "STILL MATCHES EXPECTED"

cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import random
random.seed(7)
words=[('alpha','BeTa','GaMmA'),('lorem','IpsUm','dolor'),('north','EaSt','west'),('begin','MiDdLe','end'),('first','seCond','third')]
def sp(): return ' '*random.randint(0,4)
def mid(s): return s[:1].upper()+''.join(c.upper() if random.random()<0.5 else c.lower() for c in s[1:])
with open('/tmp/fresh.csv','w') as f, open('/tmp/fresh_exp.csv','w') as g:
    for i in range(1,2001):
        a,b,c=words[i%5]
        a=a+str(i); b=b+str(i); c=c+str(i)
        ia,ib,ic=mid(a),mid(b),mid(c)
        f.write(f"{sp()}{ia}{sp()},{sp()}{ib}{sp()},{sp()}{ic}{sp()}\n")
        g.write(f"{ic.upper()};{ib.upper()};{ia.upper()};OK\n")
print("generated")
PY
head -3 /tmp/fresh.csv; head -3 /tmp/fresh_exp.csv
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/fresh.csv -S /workspace/apply_macros.vim; echo "exit=$?"
cmp /tmp/fresh_exp.csv /tmp/fresh.csv && echo "FRESH MATCH"
echo "--- verify script lines ---"
cat -n /workspace/apply_macros.vim
ls -l /workspace/apply_macros.vim
